correctness.rationale: For a binary cross-cut adjacency matrix B, summing the graph-state phases over the opposite shore gives reduced-matrix entries 2^(-|E|) exactly when the two indices differ by an element of ker B, and zero otherwise. Coset blocks give 2^rank(B) equal nonzero eigenvalues, establishing all stated entropy consequences. With the displayed odd-shore relabeling the factorization B=(I+U)(I+V) is exact even at m=2. Each shift has m orbits; their subgroups generate the even shore and intersect at 0 and (m,m). Thus every U-orbit indicator is even on every V-orbit and lies in im(I+V); the nullity is 2m. Distinct sites off the subgroup intersection are separated by a U- or V-orbit indicator. For separation across (m,m), lift one U-orbit indicator through I+V; summing the resulting difference along m V-steps gives 1, since they visit each U-orbit once. Constant one makes each evaluation nonzero. A one-step lattice translation swaps shores and gives the same assertion for the transpose kernel. For an update UV̄, surjectivity of V̄ on ker B implies im(U) is in the updated image; independence of the columns of U modulo im B then gives exactly rank(B)+rank(U). Disjoint omissions have two such coordinates on each side; shared endpoints give a rank-one update with a nonzero sum of two evaluations on one side. Fresh exact elimination on actual parity blocks reproduced all singles and pairs on C₄×C₄ and C₆×C₆ (496 and 2556 pairs), all singles and six pairs on C₈×C₈, and (10,11,11,10) on the two specified disjoint C₄×C₆ deletions. Reproduce the finite check by listing the four modulo-coordinate nearest neighbors for every odd row, clearing the listed retained-graph entries for each deletion set, and XOR-eliminating columns over F₂; compare each rank to the baseline plus 1 for a single/shared pair or 2 for a disjoint pair on the squares.
residual_risks: Fresh finite reproduction covered two squares exhaustively and two additional finite cases as specified; the frozen output reports 36,480 comparisons, partly sampled. Neither substitutes for the all-m argument.
The nonsquare finding establishes a counterexample to extending the square law to all rectangles, not a classification of all rectangles.

value.rationale: Multiple omitted preparation gates need not add their individual entanglement gains. The theorem resolves the first interaction regime for every position and circumference in a natural periodic grid family; the rectangular counterexample makes the distinction nontrivial. The kernel separation criterion explains the rigidity beyond finite examples.
residual_risks: This is a pure graph-state checkerboard-cut result, not a noisy-gate, error-correction, or general bipartition guarantee.
